english:
Each mod increases Weapon Damage by <pve 5% /> <pvp [10%] /> while within 5 meters of a Vex Relay, up to <pve 25% /> <pvp [50%] /> with 5 mods.

Enhanced copies do not stack with regular mod copies.

source.text:
While within 5 metres of a Vex Relay:

5% [10%] Increased Weapon Damage per Mod.
Maxes out at 25% [50%] with 5 Mods.

Enhanced with regular mod copies do not stack.
